content:
This is a better time to remove the top two tinted plastic panels on the sides as well since it will greatly assist in gaining access to things later.  If you are also upgrading to Gen2, you’ll need to remove them. Be careful with the plastic pop rivets that hold the panels.

Also recommend printing a gridfinity case that can hold bins for each of the types of fasteners. You can make easy labels from a Post-It for each bin.
Yes, put the screws back in the hinges as they are M3x5rT that are almost indistinguishable from the numerous M3x4rTs that you will be removing.
Smart - I missed this comment and lost those screws. Lucky I had others that fit!
After removing the door, I just screwed these 4 screws back into the hinge, so I wouldn't have to bag them and keep track of them.
